_about: E8-200 structural material properties and design allowables (SI). Generated by fea/materials.py; edit the script, not this file.

fitting.ref: CS-23.625 (Amdt 4); also applied to rotor-motor mounts, boom-wing saddles, wing root fittings, landing-gear and parachute hard points, up to the point where the section becomes typical of the member

seat_harness_attachment.ref: CS-23.785(f): seat, berth and safety-belt/harness attachments to structure

bearing_relative_motion.ref: CS-23.623(a) requires a bearing factor 'large enough' for joints with clearance under pounding or vibration; team value 2.0 on the ultimate bearing strength

control_system_joint.ref: CS-23.693: joints in push-pull systems subject to angular motion (except ball/roller bearings)

control_surface_hinge.ref: CS-23.657 via 23.623(b): plain-bearing hinges, on the ultimate bearing strength of the softest material

bonded_joint.ref: team rule for structural adhesive joints until joint-level tests exist (not a CS-23 number)

special_factors.combination: CS-23.619: only the highest pertinent special factor is applied (factors are not multiplied together); the fitting factor is not combined with a larger bearing factor (CS-23.625(b)).

k_B_fibre.basis: B-basis estimate = mean x (1 - k_B CV), CV 8 %, k_B ~1.8 (normal, n ~ 15-18), CMH-17-1G ch. 8

k_B_matrix.basis: as above with CV 10-11 % typical of wet lay-up matrix-dominated properties

k_env_tension.basis: hot/wet (60 C, moisture-saturated) for room-temperature-cure laminating epoxy, post-cured 16 h at 60-80 C, Tg(wet) >= 80 C (AC 20-107B, MCT = Tg(wet) - 28 C rule)

k_env_matrix.basis: hot/wet in-plane shear, transverse and interlaminar strengths

k_env_modulus_matrix.basis: E2, G12 at hot/wet; fibre-direction modulus unchanged

k_process.basis: wet lay-up part versus coupon: porosity, thickness/Vf scatter, fibre waviness; removed only with coupons cut from production witness panels

damage_tolerance_strain_cutoff.basis: ultimate design strain cut-off covering barely visible impact damage and open holes / fasteners (typical general-aviation practice, AC 20-107B sec. 8); the design allowable is the lower of the strength product and E x cut-off

composite_knockdowns.design_strength: F_design = F_mean x k_B x k_env x k_process (then capped by the strain cut-off)
composite_knockdowns.temperature_limit: white or light-grey paint on all composite primary structure; max structure temperature 60 C

policy.metal_basis: A-basis (or S-basis where only S is tabulated) for single-load-path parts, B-basis for redundant structure (CS-23.613). Values from MIL-HDBK-5J; check against the current MMPDS before the final design review.
policy.printed_parts: FDM parts are not used in primary structure or any load path whose failure is hazardous: tooling, jigs, fairings, cable guides only. Values below are for jig/fixture sizing.
coupon_programme: ASTM D3039 tension 0 deg and [0/90] (n >= 6 per condition, RTD and ETW 60 C saturated)
ASTM D6641 combined-loading compression, same conditions
ASTM D3518 +/-45 in-plane shear; ASTM D2344 short-beam shear on witness panels of each lay-up session
ASTM D5766 open-hole tension / D6484 open-hole compression; ASTM D5961 bearing (bolted fittings)
ASTM D7136/D7137 compression after impact for the BVID strain cut-off
ASTM D5868 / D1002 lap shear of the chosen adhesive on the actual adherends (carbon/aluminium, abraded + primed)
ASTM C273 core shear, C393/D7249 sandwich beam flexure, D7250 sandwich flexural/shear stiffness
tube 4-point bending and torsion on 3 samples of each COTS tube batch (incoming inspection)
burn-off / acid digestion (ASTM D3171) for fibre volume fraction of every witness panel

sources.rohacell_71wf_alt: https://mychem.ir/uploads/tds/16740.pdf (71 WF: shear 1.3 MPa, G 42 MPa, compression 1.7 MPa)

sources.ea9394: https://dm.henkel-dam.com/is/content/henkel/EA-9394-Aero (LOCTITE EA 9394 AERO TDS: lap shear 28.9 MPa at 25 C, 20.7 MPa at 82 C, 2024-T3 PAA, ASTM D1002)

cf_ud_wet.name: Carbon UD (T700-class 12K, 300 g/m2 stitched UD) / laminating epoxy
cf_ud_wet.process: wet lay-up, vacuum bag (>= 0.8 bar), RT cure + post-cure
cf_ud_wet.note: E1 by rule of mixtures (Vf 0.50, fibre 230 GPa); Xt = 0.65 x Vf x 4900 MPa translation for wet lay-up; Xc, matrix values from the CMH-17 Vol. 2 wet lay-up range. Used for spar caps and boom doublers.

strain_cutoff.basis: ultimate design strain cut-off covering barely visible impact damage and open holes / fasteners (typical general-aviation practice, AC 20-107B sec. 8); the design allowable is the lower of the strength product and E x cut-off

cf_fabric_wet.name: Carbon fabric 0/90 (3K 2x2 twill 200-245 g/m2, or 12K 400 g/m2) / laminating epoxy
cf_fabric_wet.process: wet lay-up, vacuum bag (>= 0.8 bar), RT cure + post-cure
cf_fabric_wet.note: Ply of balanced fabric treated as an orthotropic lamina (1 = warp). S is the +/-45 in-plane shear strength. Skins, webs, fittings, ribs (as +/-45 or 0/90 plies).

strain_cutoff.basis: ultimate design strain cut-off covering barely visible impact damage and open holes / fasteners (typical general-aviation practice, AC 20-107B sec. 8); the design allowable is the lower of the strength product and E x cut-off

eglass_fabric_wet.name: E-glass fabric (7781-style 300 g/m2 satin) / laminating epoxy
eglass_fabric_wet.process: wet lay-up, vacuum bag (>= 0.8 bar), RT cure + post-cure
eglass_fabric_wet.note: Fairings, cabin shell secondary areas, galvanic isolation ply between carbon and aluminium.

strain_cutoff.basis: ultimate design strain cut-off covering barely visible impact damage and open holes / fasteners (typical general-aviation practice, AC 20-107B sec. 8); the design allowable is the lower of the strength product and E x cut-off

cf_tube_rollwrapped_ud.name: Roll-wrapped carbon tube, UD-dominated (Rock West 'unidirectional' / DragonPlate uni roll-wrapped)
cf_tube_rollwrapped_ud.note: E 15.4 Msi, Ftu 143 ksi from the Rock West listing; compression taken as 0.6 Ftu; G and torsional shear strength low (UD-dominated wall) - torsion-critical members use the twill or +/-45 tube. Booms and wing spar tubes.

strain_cutoff.basis: ultimate design strain cut-off covering barely visible impact damage and open holes / fasteners (typical general-aviation practice, AC 20-107B sec. 8); the design allowable is the lower of the strength product and E x cut-off

knockdowns.process: none (autoclave/oven-cured prepreg by the supplier); incoming bend test per batch

cf_tube_rollwrapped_twill.name: Roll-wrapped carbon tube, 0/90 twill + UD (standard modulus)
cf_tube_rollwrapped_twill.note: Typical 8-10 Msi axial modulus for twill/UD roll-wrapped tube; preferred where torsion or crushing at clamps matters.

strain_cutoff.basis: ultimate design strain cut-off covering barely visible impact damage and open holes / fasteners (typical general-aviation practice, AC 20-107B sec. 8); the design allowable is the lower of the strength product and E x cut-off

knockdowns.process: none (autoclave/oven-cured prepreg by the supplier); incoming bend test per batch

cf_tube_pultruded.name: Pultruded carbon tube (UD, standard modulus)
cf_tube_pultruded.status: estimate (no public strength data; vendor values to be obtained)
cf_tube_pultruded.note: Very weak in hoop/torsion and prone to splitting at clamps and holes: only for pin-ended struts and stiffeners with bonded sleeves; never drilled without an overwrapped insert.

strain_cutoff.basis: ultimate design strain cut-off covering barely visible impact damage and open holes / fasteners (typical general-aviation practice, AC 20-107B sec. 8); the design allowable is the lower of the strength product and E x cut-off

knockdowns.process: none (autoclave/oven-cured prepreg by the supplier); incoming bend test per batch

pvc_h80.name: Divinycell H80 PVC foam (80 kg/m3)
pvc_h80.note: Skin and floor panels, ribs. Check face wrinkling (0.5 (Ef Ec Gc)^(1/3)) and core shear.

knockdowns.basis: datasheet minimum values x 0.80 for 60 C (PVC and PMI stiffness/strength loss) and moisture

pvc_h100.name: Divinycell H100 PVC foam (100 kg/m3)
pvc_h100.note: Spar webs, seat pan, battery tray, around inserts (potted).

knockdowns.basis: datasheet minimum values x 0.80 for 60 C (PVC and PMI stiffness/strength loss) and moisture

pvc_h45.name: Divinycell H45 PVC foam (48 kg/m3)
pvc_h45.note: Main-spar box foam (iteration 3): stabilises the +-45 webs. Values from the Diab H table, to be confirmed against the current data-sheet revision.

knockdowns.basis: datasheet minimum values x 0.80 for 60 C (PVC and PMI stiffness/strength loss) and moisture

xps_foam.name: Extruded polystyrene (XPS) board, 30-35 kg/m3 (wing cores)
xps_foam.note: Hot-wire cut wing cores; typical EN 826 / EN 12090 values (no design data): minimum assumed 0.85 x typical; visco-elastic (creep), keep sustained core stresses low.

knockdowns.basis: datasheet minimum values x 0.80 for 60 C (PVC and PMI stiffness/strength loss) and moisture

pmi_71wf.name: ROHACELL 71 WF PMI foam (75 kg/m3)
pmi_71wf.note: Alternative where heat (post-cure up to 130 C) or creep matters; minimum values taken as 0.85-0.9 x nominal where the sheet gives nominal only (to confirm with Evonik).

knockdowns.basis: datasheet minimum values x 0.80 for 60 C (PVC and PMI stiffness/strength loss) and moisture

al6061_t6_sheet.name: Aluminium 6061-T6 sheet (AMS 4027), 0.25-6 mm
al6061_t6_sheet.note: S-basis tabulated as A; B estimated +5 %. Brackets, ribs, doublers, flat waterjet parts.

knockdowns.basis: A/S-basis for single load path, B-basis for redundant; temperature <= 60 C: no reduction

al6061_t6_extr.name: Aluminium 6061-T6/T6511 extrusion (AMS-QQ-A-200/8)
al6061_t6_extr.note: Angles, channels, tubes for the cabin frame, gear cross-tubes.

knockdowns.basis: A/S-basis for single load path, B-basis for redundant; temperature <= 60 C: no reduction

al6061_t6_welded.name: Aluminium 6061-T6, as-welded (heat-affected zone)
al6061_t6_welded.note: Within 25 mm of a weld. Welded aluminium is avoided in primary structure.

knockdowns.basis: A/S-basis for single load path, B-basis for redundant; temperature <= 60 C: no reduction

al7075_t6_sheet.name: Aluminium 7075-T6 sheet (QQ-A-250/12), 1.0-3.2 mm
al7075_t6_sheet.note: Machined fittings from plate use the plate table (lower ST values); no welding; notch-sensitive in fatigue.

knockdowns.basis: A/S-basis for single load path, B-basis for redundant; temperature <= 60 C: no reduction

steel_4130_n.name: 4130 steel, normalized tube/sheet (MIL-T-6736 / AMS 6350), t <= 4.8 mm
steel_4130_n.note: S-basis. Outsourced welded tube structure (cabin cage / gear) only if justified.

knockdowns.basis: A/S-basis for single load path, B-basis for redundant; temperature <= 60 C: no reduction

steel_4130_welded.name: 4130 steel, fusion welded, not heat-treated after welding
steel_4130_welded.note: Joint allowable for welded clusters (MIL-HDBK-5J welded-joint section); Fty and Fsu estimated in proportion. To be confirmed before use.

knockdowns.basis: A/S-basis for single load path, B-basis for redundant; temperature <= 60 C: no reduction

steel_an_bolt.name: AN/NAS alloy steel bolt (125 ksi Ftu, 75 ksi Fsu)
steel_an_bolt.note: Shear on the shank area; bearing checked on the softer joint member.

knockdowns.basis: A/S-basis for single load path, B-basis for redundant; temperature <= 60 C: no reduction

cf_fabric_wet_bearing.name: Bolted bearing, quasi-isotropic carbon fabric wet lay-up, e/D >= 3, W/D >= 5, finger-tight + washers
cf_fabric_wet_bearing.note: ASTM D5961 to be run. Bearing in wet lay-up laminates uses 2 % offset strength for limit and ultimate bearing x knock-downs for ultimate; bonded metal inserts preferred for rotor mounts.

ea9394.name: LOCTITE EA 9394 AERO epoxy paste
ea9394.note: Structural joints: spar-cap to web, rotor-mount inserts, boom sleeves. Abrade + solvent wipe composite; aluminium phosphoric-acid anodize or sol-gel.

knockdowns.rule: tau_design = lap-shear at the max service temperature x 0.8 (scatter / surface preparation) x 0.5 (average-to-peak stress for short, stiff overlaps; peel controlled with tapered ends and fillets); the bonded-joint special factor 1.5 is then applied to the ultimate load

ma530.name: Plexus MA530 methacrylate
ma530.note: Secondary bonds and large-gap (to 18 mm) joints: skins to ribs, fairings, cable trays. Extra 0.7 factor for strength at 60 C (no elevated-temperature data on the TDS).

knockdowns.rule: tau_design = lap-shear at the max service temperature x 0.8 (scatter / surface preparation) x 0.5 (average-to-peak stress for short, stiff overlaps; peel controlled with tapered ends and fillets); the bonded-joint special factor 1.5 is then applied to the ultimate load
